summary: An assistant suggests text and you apply it; an agent reads files, edits them and runs commands in a loop. You give an agent one small task on a branch, watch its steps, write them down, and judge them: did it read before it edited, did it check its own work, did it decide something the task did not ask for. You read the diff before the summary.
goal: Give an agent one small task and watch its steps.

items.text: Commit, make a branch and save the baseline table
Give your agent the small task and watch its steps without helping
Write the table of its steps: tool, what it did, what it learned
Answer: did it read first, check its work, touch other files or decide on its own
Read git diff line by line before its summary, then commit
Play the Agent Steps game to the end and see your score
